subject: Evidence handoff + owner questions for ISO/FedRAMP cadence

Subject: Follow-up: evidence handoff and owner list for ISO/FedRAMP

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Orion's audit team asked for a concise owner map and a clear handoff plan for the evidence we'll need for both ISO 27001 scoping and FedRAMP readiness. They flagged a few near-term priorities: control owner confirmations, evidence location (S3 vs Box), and sampling window dates for the upcoming assessment in Q1.

Attached is the high-level questionnaire they shared and the initial SIG/CAIQ checklist. Can you confirm:
- Who on your side will own control evidence for IAM and Logging controls?
- Where will you place the artifacts (we prefer a single shared folder or a signed URL list)?
- Proposed dates for evidence freeze and sampling window (they want a 30-day window in Jan).

We aim to lock the owner list by Nov 12 so the auditors can send their sample requests. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Compliance Operations
Orion Financial

Laura —

Thanks for the clear ask and the templates. Quick answers to your bullets below, and then a couple of clarifying questions.

- Control owners:
  - IAM (user provisioning / deprovisioning): Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.com)
  - Logging/Monitoring retention: Mina Haddad (mina_haddad@redwood.com)
  - Network segmentation / firewall rules: Alex Martinez (that's me)
  - Key management (KMS/HSM): Grace O'Connor (I'll loop her on the next message)

- Evidence location: we propose a single read-only Box folder. We can publish expiring signed URLs for any S3-only artifacts, but Box is the canonical location.

- Dates: evidence freeze 2027-01-10, sampling window 2027-01-15 to 2027-02-13 (30 days). If your auditors need earlier samples we can adjust but this is our current baseline given upcoming release freezes.

Clarifying Qs:
1) For FedRAMP scoping: do they expect the cloud provider controls to be included in your sample or can we mark them out (we're assuming shared responsibility where applicable).
2) Are there any SIG/CAIQ questions they want prioritized for earlier turnaround (we can batch answers for high-risk controls first).

I'll attach our internal evidence tracker (CSV) after I sync with Grace.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

--

- Logging retention: Mina, please confirm retention buckets and retention period evidence (screenshots of retention policy, S3 lifecycle JSON, and examples of preserved logs). Auditors typically ask for a sample of preserved logs for two systems.

- Sampling window: Jan 15 - Feb 13 is workable, but we need to schedule release freezes with Product. Alex, can you confirm we don't have a planned infra rollout that week?

Action items I propose:
- Monica: confirm provisioning/deprovisioning runbook and latest user access review (due Nov 12).
- Mina: upload retention evidence and two log samples to the Box folder by Nov 19.
- Alex: confirm infra freeze / network change blackout dates by Nov 10.

I'll prepare the initial SIG/CAIQ answer set for low-effort questions and share a draft by Nov 17.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Platform Security
